1, not 3.

Inside this click, count is 0 the whole time. All three calls say "set it to 0 + 1". React batches them, and the result is 1.

When the next value depends on the previous one, pass a function:
setCount(c => c + 1)
React queues these and runs each with the latest value, so three calls give 3.

Source: react.dev, Queueing a series of state updates.
